method: Locked versions authoritative; locally installed matching versions supply declared metadata and license/NOTICE files. Platform markers retained as conservative runtime candidates, not evaluated against target Docker images. No network lookup or legal approval.
excluded_scope: Docker base images, operating-system libraries, copied uv executable and PostgreSQL/pgvector image notices
Build tools and development-only dependencies (see explicit excluded lists)
Reproducible video project dependencies and assets (separate distribution)
blockers: Local macOS installed metadata cannot establish full Linux Docker runtime notices, including native bundled libraries.
Absent optional platform packages have lockfile license expressions only; target-image notice files must be collected before container redistribution.
Psycopg/psycopg-binary LGPL obligations and bundled native library source/notice requirements need distribution-specific review.
Next.js compiled/vendored dependency license files are retained, but this is not a complete final-image SBOM or legal clearance.
Project license is undecided; no project LICENSE was introduced.
